races.paceDynamic: Quercus stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and should get an easy lead in this moderate handicap field. The Gay Blade may track him from a prominent position, but with most runners preferring to sit back including hold-up specialists Sedgemoor, Fircombe Hall, and Asadjumeirah, the early pace will be pedestrian. This creates a tactical race where the front two get first run, but leaves plenty of time for closers to organize their challenge down the home straight. The soft pace and sustained finish strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver one run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest and Quercus leads unchallenged to the turn
scenarios.body: Sedgemoor and Fircombe Hall get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace. The weak early gallop allows patient riders to time their challenges perfectly in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Two Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Quercus and The Gay Blade establish a decisive advantage turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate pace means they retain enough energy to resist late challenges. Quercus particularly benefits from getting such an easy lead while The Gay Blade's prominent style pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If The Gay Blade or others apply early pressure to Quercus creating honest fractions
scenarios.body: This brings stamina into play and suits horses like Auntie Jo who can stay strongly. The genuine pace also helps Asadjumeirah who needs something to aim at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Quercus goes too slowly and the field bunches up turning in
scenarios.body: A cavalry charge develops where luck in running becomes crucial. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalize but traffic problems eliminate others from contention.

watchPoints.text: Quercus sets the pace but his 170-day layoff could see him fold quickly if put under any pressure
Traffic problems likely in straight as multiple hold-up horses converge on limited racing room
Sedgemoor's first-time blinkers could provide the edge needed to capitalize on ideal race conditions
The Gay Blade's fitness after 40 days off may prevent him from sustaining his prominent position
Fircombe Hall ran without his usual cheekpieces last time which contributed to his poor showing

races.paceDynamic: Clansman is the sole confirmed front runner and will lead from the off with no pace pressure, allowing him to dictate terms at a comfortable gallop. Moon Sniper and Roger Henry may sit prominent but neither has the pace to seriously challenge for the early lead. The lack of genuine pace setters means this will become a tactical affair with a moderate tempo throughout, before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, as the patient riders on Patrol, Mao Shang Wong and Analogical will have every chance to get into the race late when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Clansman gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The veteran controls the pace perfectly and has enough left to resist late challenges, benefiting front runners who can dictate. His recent C&D win and strong recent form makes him hard to peg back when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and suits patient types
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo plays into the hands of hold-up horses who can unleash their finishing kicks. Analogical and Mao Shang Wong have shown strong finishing ability and will benefit from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Sniper or Roger Henry can track the leader and pounce
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip behind Clansman and have enough to kick clear when the pace lifts. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the field while avoiding the worst of any late traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Winner
scenarios.trigger: If Patrol produces his best form from off the pace
scenarios.body: The most patient hold-up horse benefits from an even slower pace than expected and arrives with a telling late run. His dead-heat win at similar trip last April shows he has the ability when conditions align perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Clansman could steal this if he gets too soft a lead early and isn't pressured by the limited pace in the field
Moon Sniper's 80-day absence could leave him short of peak fitness despite his new stable change
Mao Shang Wong failed badly when stepped up to 1m4f last time, watch if he handles the extra two furlongs better
Analogical has been narrowly beaten twice this year and could be due a change of fortune on same handicap mark
Roger Henry needs to bounce back from his poor stable debut, watch for signs of improvement back over longer trip

races.paceDynamic: Lindoro is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure. The majority of runners (Masai Angel, Kilfrush Desert, Gouken, Likeadyinwasp, Slot) are hold-up types who will need to be delivered late, while Nebulon provides the main prominent threat to track Lindoro. With limited early pace and most dangers coming from behind, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early. The tactical verdict clearly benefits those who can avoid the inevitable late traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lindoro leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lindoro breaks cleanly and maintains his front running style without serious early challenge
scenarios.body: He sets fractions to suit and proves hard to peg back despite his moderate recent form, while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic late. This lack of early pressure allows the leader to control the race and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker wins
scenarios.trigger: If Nebulon can track Lindoro closely and deliver his challenge at the right moment
scenarios.body: The runner-up from Wolverhampton gets the perfect stalking trip behind the uncontested leader and has the proven AW form to strike. His recent second suggests he's ready to win and this tactical position suits perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and allows the backmarkers a clear run through
scenarios.body: Gouken's consistency across five placed efforts gives him the edge in a slowly-run race where his hold-up style can be effective. The gelding operation since his last run could provide the extra improvement needed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If either April Diamond or Alfa Impulsion shows significant improvement on debut or return
scenarios.body: The breeding suggests both newcomers have untapped ability that could surface on this AW surface. Their unknown quantities make them dangerous if the market money comes for either.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Lindoro breaks poorly or gets challenged early, as this would completely change the pace dynamic
Monitor the market for either April Diamond or Alfa Impulsion, as money would suggest hidden ability
Check if Gouken shows any early pace change from his usual hold-up style following the gelding operation
Watch for any pre-race antics from Slot given her history of running loose before the start
Observe if Masai Angel shows any improvement from his poor Hamilton debut after the long break and gelding

races.paceDynamic: Fille Unique is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead with Bella Delizia, Golden Havana, Perfect Price and Jane Of The Jungle settling prominently behind her. The substantial hold-up contingent of Territorial Star, Enter Sandman, Data Fata Secutus, O Fortuna and Nana's Boy George will be tracking from the rear over this sharp 5f trip. With no pressure on the leader, this sets up as a steady pace that will quicken late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as the hold-up horses face a significant task over the minimum distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Fille Unique sets a comfortable pace and the prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Bella Delizia, Golden Havana or Jane Of The Jungle to position perfectly and strike before the backmarkers can get organised. The 5f trip gives insufficient time for the hold-up horses to mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and bunches the field
scenarios.body: Territorial Star or O Fortuna benefit from their recent promising form and get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kick. The compressed field creates gaps for the patient riders to exploit in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Fille Unique gets easy fractions and has enough left
scenarios.body: The mare capitalises on her uncontested position and Paul Mulrennan times the acceleration perfectly to hold off late challengers. Her recent solid effort at this course gives her the confidence to see out the trip under minimal pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with multiple horses hitting the front simultaneously in a blanket finish. The backmarkers get their ideal scenario but traffic problems and lack of room create unpredictable outcomes.

races.paceDynamic: Call Me Betty, Blazing Son, and Lord Capulet will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with three confirmed front-runners guaranteeing no hiding place over this demanding 7f trip. The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves, particularly with Call Me Betty fresh from a break and Lord Capulet seeking to regain his early-season form when dominating from the front. This honest pace scenario will expose any lack of fitness and create a true test of stamina. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early pace battle will set up the race perfectly for late closers with proven stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage early and maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will stretch the field and set up perfectly for horses with proven finishing kicks who can pick up the pieces. Hold-up performers with stamina will be ideally positioned as the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: Lord Capulet or Call Me Betty could dictate terms if the others don't press hard enough early. Their class and C&D experience would be decisive in a more tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get perfect positioning behind the early pace
scenarios.body: Criminal Shore and Ziggy's Condor could benefit from tracking the leaders without doing the donkey work. They would have the tactical advantage of cover while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go too fast and tie up badly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: An extreme pace scenario where even the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Any horse with tactical speed who avoided the early battle could capitalize on the carnage.

races.paceDynamic: Esque Elegance is the only confirmed front-runner and will set a comfortable pace without pressure through the early stages. Wheres The Crumpet and Martin's Brig can sit prominent but both are inconsistent pace factors. The lack of early speed will create a slowly-run race that builds gradually, setting up a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll get the patient ride and quick ground they need to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Esque Elegance sets uncontested fractions and no prominent horse applies pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where hold-up horses get first run on quick ground. Late finishers with tactical speed like Pebble Dash and Starshot can pick off the tired pace-setter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Esque Elegance stops quickly and prominent horses fail to capitalize
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely in the final furlong creating chaos where any horse with a late rattle can win. Long-priced hold-up horses who stay strongly get their chance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Wheres The Crumpet or Martin's Brig press Esque Elegance early
scenarios.body: Increased pace benefits horses that can travel kindly in midfield and have gears to change. The pace duel sets up horses like Cloch Nua who can quicken when others weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Esque Elegance gets soft fractions and finds extra when challenged
scenarios.body: The pace-setter uses the easy lead to conserve energy and kicks again in the straight. Her recent seconds at this track suggest she has the stamina to last home.
